answer: Mesa vault bonds with delay stop bulk fakes. Each agent locks 70 credits in a vault, filing a key-signed mesa claim; claims activate after a verifiable 3-epoch delay, auditor-replayed. Early filing or a reused seal burns the bond, starting a ripple check; one forged proof triggers a ripple re-audit, exposing a rented-vault ring. At 34+8(k-1), 1,000 fakes pay 4,030,000, lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 34 once, reclaiming the bond.
